name: fusion-vision-mcp
description: An MCP server fusing Florence-2 and Moondream2 for image captioning, OCR, object detection/grounding, and visual question answering

tools.name: ocr
tools.description: Process an image file or URL using OCR to extract text.

tools.name: caption
tools.description: Processes an image file and generates captions for the image.

tools.name: detect_objects
tools.description: Detect instances of a named object in an image, returning bounding boxes.

tools.name: point_objects
tools.description: Locate instances of a named object in an image, returning center coordinates.

tools.name: dense_region_caption
tools.description: Generate a caption for every salient region of an image, with bounding boxes.

tools.name: query_image
tools.description: Ask a free-form question about an image (visual question answering), backed by Moondream2.

tools.name: analyze_image
tools.description: Multi-purpose image analysis tool dispatching to caption/ocr/detect/point/dense_caption/query.

tools.name: batch_analyze_images
tools.description: Runs analyze_image's operation over several images, reporting per-image success or failure.

tools.name: spatial_relations
tools.description: Measure contact, gaps, containment depth and shape between named objects using SAM2 masks.

tools.name: process
tools.description: Processes an image file with a custom prompt using the Florence-2 model.
